edges.reason: tx.origin is used as the key of _holderLastTransferTimestamp to enforce one purchase per block, making the anti-bot check depend on a caller-supplied origin.
block.timestamp drives the early-sell tax window (_holderFirstBuyTimestamp + 0 hours >= block.timestamp), making fee logic miner-influenceable.
block.timestamp is passed as the swap deadline to the router.
block.timestamp is passed as the addLiquidityETH deadline.
Caller identity flows into _transfer indirectly through balanceOf/allowance checks and _msgSender().
msg.sender is used as the allowance owner and source address in the Chire transferFrom loop.
Chire grants owner() an unlimited self-allowance of totalSupply() before looping transfers.
Chire executes an unbounded transferFrom loop over caller-supplied arrays with no length equality check.
_transfer calls swapBack() mid-transfer while token balances and fee state are still being settled.
swapBack forwards ETH to devWallet with a low-level call that can execute arbitrary recipient code.
swapBack forwards the entire remaining ETH balance to marketingWallet with a low-level call.
The devWallet ETH recipient can re-enter _transfer (and thus swapBack) before the outer transfer completes.
The marketingWallet ETH recipient can re-enter _transfer before the outer transfer completes.
swapBack invokes swapTokensForEth to convert accumulated tokens.
swapBack invokes addLiquidity when both liquidity tokens and liquidity ETH are available.
swapTokensForEth performs the external router swap with amountOutMin hardcoded to 0.
addLiquidity performs the external router addLiquidityETH call with zero slippage bounds.
_transfer reads and writes _holderLastTransferTimestamp keyed on tx.origin.
_transfer reads and writes _holderFirstBuyTimestamp to decide the early sell tax.
_transfer writes _blacklist[to] during the launch block, letting the owner-controlled logic censor arbitrary buyers.
_transfer recomputes sellTotalFees from individual sell fee components in the early-sell branch.
_transfer uses buyTotalFees in the fee formula amount.mul(buyTotalFees).div(100).
_transfer reads and relies on the swapping flag as its only reentrancy guard around swapBack.
_transfer compares the contract token balance with swapTokensAtAmount to trigger swapBack.
_transfer reads launchedAt for the anti-bot sniper blacklist condition.
enableTrading writes launchedAt = block.number.
enableTrading permanently sets tradingActive = true.
enableTrading permanently sets swapEnabled = true.
updateBuyFees sums the buy fee components into buyTotalFees and enforces the <= 0 bound.
updateSellFees sums the sell fee components into sellTotalFees and enforces the <= 0 bound.
_setAutomatedMarketMakerPair writes the automatedMarketMakerPairs mapping.
setAutomatedMarketMakerPair delegates to the private helper.
The constructor marks the created pair as an automated market maker.
updateMarketingWallet rewrites the marketingWallet state variable.
updateDevWallet rewrites the devWallet state variable.
excludeFromFees writes the _isExcludedFromFees mapping.
excludeFromMaxTransaction writes the _isExcludedMaxTransactionAmount mapping.
updateSwapTokensAtAmount writes swapTokensAtAmount after bounds checks.
swapBack reads and then zeroes tokensForMarketing while splitting ETH.
swapBack reads and then zeroes tokensForLiquidity while halving the token amount.
swapBack reads and then zeroes tokensForDev while splitting ETH.
swapBack uses the mutable marketingWallet as the destination of the final ETH transfer.
swapBack uses the mutable devWallet as the destination of a low-level ETH transfer.
